name: Guaraciana
text: A warm light gathers in the dust,\nlike the first minutes of morning.

name: Tupanaú
text: The air tastes of iron.\nSomething thunders without a sound.

name: Fogaréu
text: Embers drift up out of nowhere.\nThe stone here is warm to the touch.

name: Yasy
text: A pale glow, like moonlight,\nthough no window opens here.

name: Kuarahy
text: The floor glows gold.\nThe oldest sun is watching you.

name: Arauanamon
text: The wind stops. The sea goes still.\pSomething as old as the land itself\nstands at the foot of the tower.

name: Arauanaú
text: It is said to appear only when\nthe region is in danger.\pIt is looking straight at you.

name: Terraão
text: Green shoots have pushed up\nthrough the cave floor here.

name: Solzão
text: This heat is not the volcano's.\nThe ground is cracked and dry.

name: Perybé
text: The water hums with the voices\nof a thousand faraway rivers.

name: Iaraú
text: A song rises from the water.\nThe whole pond holds its breath.

name: Verdejante
text: Fresh leaves grow out of old ash\nall around this clearing.

name: Poente
text: The sand still holds the colors\nof a sunset long gone.

name: Marulho
text: The waves fall into one rhythm,\nas if keeping time for someone.

name: Jaciana
text: A silver light, like midnight,\nshines over the shallows.

name: Chuvão
text: Rain falls on this islet alone.\nThe cloud above it has eyes.

name: Rudarauna
text: A gentle warmth drifts over\nthe water, like a held hand.

name: Boitatã
text: Two coals glow in the ash.\nThey are eyes. They are watching.

name: Ventania
text: A cold south wind whistles\na tune no one ever taught it.

name: Sacinho
text: A small whirlwind spins in place.\nIt sounds like someone giggling.
